positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● As part of the PowerApps team, I worked on delivering new language features, a large rewrite of the analysis engine to improve performance by 40%, and maintaining and enhancing the editing experience for low code development
● Leveraged large language models to work with the PowerFx language and the PowerApps AI native, connecting model to user end to end, refining prompts, and setting up test infrastructure for continuous iteration and improvements
● Participated in a rigorous on-call rotation, improving process flows to streamline the burden by creating service monitors for KPIs, new incidents, exceptions, and improving telemetry for investigation into existing issues, with regular direct support calls with F500 companies

positions.title: Full-stack Web Developer
positions.description:
• Contributed to API development using Node.js and Express to migrate aging codebase and
develop new functionality, utilizing Docker and Jest for workflow and unit testing.
• Expanded internal reporting and metrics system by combining fields across multiple tables,
enabling reporting configuration through web interface, and archiving data.
• Updated existing external libraries and bringing codebase up to date to ensure compatibility.
• Built a React web application for internal administration use to moderate customers
and track product feedback.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Completed full-stack bootcamp focusing on Spring Boot web development
•	Created chat communications bot that uses multiple external APIs for purposes such as authentication and automated notifications
•	Developed web services for global toy and entertainment company for multiple markets in a global team using HTML, CSS (SASS), JQuery, React, and PHP
•	Ensured all websites adhered to responsive web design, SEO, and page speed standards
•	Coordinated between various business units such as marketing, legal, operations, and QA teams in an Agile environment

positions.title: IT Application Services Intern
positions.description:
·         Assist Vendor application team with annual vendor reviews, and risk analysis updates,
including organizing and filing review work

·         Assist with reconciling application listings in ServiceNow (CMDB) and business continuity
platforms

·         Research and document annual roadmap updates for critical business applications

·         Assist with dashboard and report writing for Application team metrics

·         Analyze application maintenance costs and reconcile to contractual obligations for critical
vendors

·         Organize application team documentation and project artifacts

·         Other misc. project assistance as needed including organizing calls and meetings and taking
meeting notes

positions.title: Business Consultant Intern
positions.description:
·        Worked with a designated project manager, project team members, clients/users and colleagues to design, test and deploy integrated solutions, using Company tools 

·        Documented all work using department standards, methods and tools, so that they can be supported by other members of the business, e.g. support or development 

·        Kept documentation and internal knowledge base up-to-date 

·        Handled multiple assignments/projects simultaneously

·        Learned and applied new technologies and business concepts 

·        Maintained personal accountability for getting things done on time and with quality results 

·        Worked effectively both in a team environment as well as independently with minimal supervision

positions.title: Student Technician
positions.description: ·         Assisted students, faculty and staff with computer lab and classroom technology

positions.title: Web Development Project
positions.description:
o	Designed, developed, and implemented a database to track whelping with a mobile-friendly website serving over 50 users in a nonprofit
o	Used JavaScript, PHP and MySQL
o	Provided user access control and data entry adhering to security best practices to ensure continuity after go-live
